items.title: Equitas Small Finance Bank devalues Diamond tier benefits on PowerMiles and Selfe credit cards
items.why: Cutting premium-tier perks invites churn; use this as a cautionary case when designing or renegotiating tier benefits.
items.summary_ai: Equitas Small Finance Bank has cut Diamond tier benefits on its PowerMiles and Selfe credit cards.

items.title: Equitas SFB to exceed growth targets in Q3, apply for universal bank licence in 2027
items.why: Equitas Small Finance Bank expects to beat its Q3 growth targets and plans to apply for a universal banking licence in 2027.
